title: Glowing motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow halos -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='70' r='22' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='70' r='22' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='70' r='14' fill='#2b2b4a'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='70' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='70' r='5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='70' r='14' fill='#2b2b4a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='70' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='70' r='5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- spokes -->
  <g stroke='#ffb400' stroke-width='1.5'>
    <line x1='27' y1='57' x2='27' y2='63'/>
    <line x1='27' y1='77' x2='27' y2='83'/>
    <line x1='14' y1='70' x2='20' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='70' x2='40' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='57' x2='73' y2='63'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='77' x2='73' y2='83'/>
    <line x1='60' y1='70' x2='66' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='80' y1='70' x2='86' y2='70'/>
  </g>
  <!-- frame -->
  <path d='M27 70 L46 58 L64 58 L73 70' fill='none' stroke='#39e0c8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='58' x2='58' y2='40' stroke='#39e0c8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body / tank -->
  <path d='M48 56 L60 42 L72 44 L70 58 Z' fill='#7b5cff'/>
  <path d='M48 56 L60 42 L72 44 L70 58 Z' fill='none' stroke='#a98bff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M40 55 L52 50 L60 52 L58 58 L44 60 Z' fill='#3a2f7a'/>
  <path d='M40 55 L52 50 L60 52' fill='none' stroke='#8a7be0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- handlebars -->
  <line x1='60' y1='40' x2='68' y2='32' stroke='#39e0c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='31' x2='73' y2='33' stroke='#39e0c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='36' r='6' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='36' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- headlight beam -->
  <path d='M81 31 L96 24 L96 48 L81 41 Z' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <rect x='34' y='64' width='18' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#c0c0e0'/>
  <rect x='34' y='64' width='18' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e8e8ff'/>
  <!-- engine block -->
  <rect x='44' y='60' width='14' height='9' rx='2' fill='#5a5a8f'/>
  <rect x='44' y='60' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a8ac0'/>
  <!-- tiny glow sparkle -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
